native_patch.finding: The prior patch fixed generic typed-readback admission, but positive proof still ignored the bridge's returned action and post-effect target. A valid-looking readback from another executable/window/session/generation was reproducibly admitted as EFFECT_PROVEN.
native_patch.previous_finding: The Windows executor already checked typed readback, but receipt projection trusted the caller's outcome. The original unit test admitted EFFECT_PROVEN with only {readback:true}.
changes: One shared action-specific typed-readback predicate used by executor and receipt projection.
Positive proof additionally requires the fixed bridge effect schema and the exact returned action, including when different actions share UIA_VALUE_EXACT.
The recorded post-effect target is normalized and hashed; all seven identity fields must match the validated request target and declared request digest.
Missing/malformed identity, mismatched action, executable SHA or generation become AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY without a second physical dispatch.
Receipt projection revalidates the typed request, DB-lease binding and exact target identity.
Unsupported positive proof is downgraded to AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY; delivery-only invoke/key/pointer never becomes semantic proof.
NO_EFFECT_PROVEN requires an explicit boolean effect_started:false in recorded evidence.
Local visual-fence rejection records the pre-effect boundary without dispatch.
No automatic replay, new scheduler, arbitrary shell or eval introduced.

research.finding: UIA RuntimeId is desktop-local, opaque and reusable over time. It is not a substitute for the exact machine/session/process-incarnation/window/executable/generation binding.
A UIA element can disappear and GetRuntimeId can throw ElementNotAvailableException. Missing/malformed post-effect evidence must not become semantic success or proof of no effect.
ValuePattern is a control capability, not a generic transport success proof; unsupported/read-only controls and absent value readback must preserve conservative outcomes.

trust_limit: The fixed hash-verified bridge remains the runner trust boundary. Matching envelope/schema strings are necessary consistency checks, not cryptographic authentication of arbitrary caller-supplied evidence.
